notes.title: Orca updates itself
notes.detail: When a better version is ready, Orca tells you and updates in one click. It never interrupts you: updates go in when you quit.

notes.title: A clearer menu bar list
notes.detail: On macOS 26 the menu bar list has the new Mac glass look and stays easy to read over any window.

notes.title: No more blue outlines
notes.detail: Clicking around Orca no longer draws blue rings around buttons and fields.
